00b36bc13a5e0cab.description: **About Decentro** Decentro is a Y-Combinator backed banking & payments infrastructure company. While starting our first fintech venture back in 2014, we spent years convincing banks to partner with us. Before we could launch our fintech product (more here), we had to convince different departments within banks - including technology, business, leadership, legal, and support to get the green signal. Fast forward to today, we realise that banks & regulatory institutions find it difficult to help the longer tail of companies build innovative & compliant fintech solutions. What if there was a platform (think AWS for cloud or Twilio for messaging) that abstracts the complexities of banking, identity, payments, lending, and provides simple APIs so that companies do not have to spend years dealing with banks? We’re solving this pain point at Decentro since 2020. We’ve scaled to process $4 billion + in payment volumes & have 1400+ customers across India & Singapore in multiple verticals such as marketplaces, banks, regulated institutions, fintechs, lenders, gaming, and more. Decentro’s engineering roles explicitly emphasize Python and database design as core skills. * Solid understanding of data modeling, schema design, warehouse design, and query optimization. * Experience with orchestration and pipeline tooling such as Airflow, Dagster, Kafka, Spark, or equivalent systems. * Familiarity with cloud-native data infrastructure on AWS or GCP, including object storage, compute, managed databases, and warehousing systems. * Strong experience with database design and management, which aligns closely with Decentro’s existing backend hiring patterns. * Good understanding of APIs, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, and service- to-service integrations. * Appreciation for clean, well-documented code, version control, testing discipline, and production-grade engineering practices, all of which are highlighted in Decentro’s published engineering roles. * High ownership, strong problem-solving ability, and a willingness to learn and adapt quickly, matching the team qualities called out in Decentro’s job listings. **Good to have** * Experience in fintech, banking, lending, payments, or regulated infrastructure environments. * Exposure to reconciliation systems, settlement workflows, ledgering, or risk and fraud datasets. * Working knowledge of data governance, PII protection, encryption, and audit trail requirements. * Familiarity with BI and self-serve analytics tooling such as Metabase, Looker, or Superset. * Experience building internal developer platforms, data APIs, or reusable platform abstractions. **What We Offer** The ability for you to make an impact and lay a foundation for the upcoming fin-tech innovations. A multicultural and diverse team of colleagues from different states that speak in total of 6 Indian and global languages. Progressive and flexible work hours that match your personality and lifestyle. The best-in-class perks and benefits for the team. Check out our careers page for the same: https://decentro.tech/careers/https://decentro.tech/careers/ Backed by global investors such as Ycombinator & Rapyd, we're a contrarian and progressive culture of independent thinkers and systematic executors that are driven to build cool things that matter. If this aligns with you, time to hop on! We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. **Apply here**- https://decentro.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/146580

Public Sector Partnerships Lead - India
About the role
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across India, reporting to our APAC Regional Lead. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across India, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.
In this role, you will:
Drive government adoption and revenue (primary)
• 
Identify government partnership opportunities across India — from healthcare and education to transport, public sector banks, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products.
• 
Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across Indian government institutions — spanning central ministries, agencies, public sector banks, and SOEs — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.
• 
Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.
Build strategic partnerships (secondary)
• 
Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups.
• 
Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.
Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary)
• 
Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across India, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.
• 
Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company.
• 
Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.
• 
Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.
• 
Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.
Who you are:
• 
You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.
• 
You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.
• 
You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.
• 
You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.
• 
You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.
What you bring:
Primary requirements
• 
10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes, not solely policy or regulatory roles.
• 
A wide, current network of contacts across Indian government institutions — spanning central ministries, agencies, healthcare, education, transport, public sector banks, and other SOEs. Prior government experience is a plus but not required if network breadth is strong.
• 
Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.
• 
Contacts or experience across other South or Southeast Asian markets is a plus.
Also required
• 
Strong knowledge of the regional AI policy landscape, including general AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and digital rights.
• 
Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.
• 
Public policy experience across India.
• 
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.
• 
Fluency in English and Hindi.

This role is located in India.
